## Problem Statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Why does the current behavior fall short? Concrete is better than abstract.

## Proposed Solution

How would you solve it? Sketches, pseudo-code, or a sketch of the API are welcome.

```solidity
// Optional: pseudo-code or interface sketch
```

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you weigh, and why is your proposal better? If you don't have alternatives, that's fine; honesty beats false symmetry.

## Roadmap Fit

The internal roadmap drives priorities. Features that align with the ERC-4626 + W3C VC + EIP-712 attestation pattern (eIDAS 2.0 / MiCA / RWA context) merge faster. Features outside that scope may sit or be politely declined.

If unsure whether your idea fits, open the issue anyway and ask.
